A '''kolto tank''' was a healing canister where a patient would remain inside, completely submerged in a solution of the healing agent [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]], until their wounds were healed. During its peak, kolto tanks could be found aboard Republic starships, inside government buildings and in medical facilities. The concentration of kolto could be tailored to the patient, allowing for different solutions to be input.
